title: What's New in HabitKit (vertical feature reel)
summary: A 15 s vertical 'what's new' reel for HabitKit, a habit tracker. Dark navy-black canvas with soft coloured glows; the app's coloured-square habit grid assembles from flying tiles into the logo, then each feature gets a two-line bold headline at the top (with a coloured ? or . accent) above a real-looking phone screen: new habit types (segmented control Yes/No · Count · Measure), decimals and units (ring counter), hide completed habits, iCloud backup, restore on a new phone. Tiles explode out and re-form the logo at the end. Crisp, native-app polish.
fit_reason: A perfect vertical 'feature drop' format: headline top, phone UI below, one feature per 2-3 s; directly reusable for SaaSSuite release notes on Reels/Shorts.

palette.mood: dark premium with soft multicolour glows; lavender-violet brand accent

typography.display: rounded bold grotesk (SF Pro Rounded Bold / Nunito Black)
typography.size_behaviour: large two-line headline at top third, centred; tiny tracked caps eyebrow ('NEW HABIT TYPES', 'WHAT'S NEW IN')
typography.notes: Punctuation coloured in the brand violet ('Done for today?' '?'; 'Out of the way.' '.'). Wordmark 'HabitKit' with 'Kit' in violet.

text_animation: headline lines blur-fade up one after another
second line words appear word by word with blur
segmented control pill slides between options with label update below
motion: dozens of coloured tiles fly in with spin and settle into the grid (and explode out at end)
cloud icon with dotted arc path and orbiting coloured squares
second phone slides in overlapping (old → new phone)
ui_treatment: Real app screens inside dark iPhone frames, mostly one phone centred at bottom 60% of frame; UI controls (segmented control, hide pill) lifted out and enlarged above the phone.

UI control lifted out of the phone and enlarged above it

'Done for today? Out of the way.' headline, Hide pill taps, list collapses, scroll-blur to next

recreate.prompt: Vertical dark feature-drop reel: coloured tiles fly in to form the logo, then each feature has a bold rounded two-line headline at the top with a violet punctuation accent, the relevant UI control enlarged above a phone showing the app, soft colour glows behind.
